paragraphs: Rav Zevid of Nehardea. Rashi, Kiddushin 72b, explains that he is not the unqualified Rav Zevid. Amemar stated a teaching before him: Bava Metzia 73b. Rav Huna bar Natan heard from him: Kiddushin 72b. Rav Kahana stated a teaching before him: Yevamot 18b, 48b; Bava Kamma 16a, 71b; Arakhin 6a; Sanhedrin 69b. Rav Kahana eulogized him in Pum Nehara: Moed Katan 27b. Rav Zevid was academy head in Pumbedita eight years (see part 1,year 4132).
